name: Spark of Hope
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, hope, mind-affecting]; Level bard 0, mesmerist 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 minute or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This spell imbues the target with a swelling sense of hope.

For the duration of the spell or until it is discharged, the target gets a +1 morale bonus on saves vs. fear and despair effects. On any other saving throw, attack roll skill check, the target may discharge the spell to gain a +1 morale bonus on that roll.
